video_title: Rick Carlisle and Kelly Oubre Jr. Media Availability | October 12, 2026

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle praises Kelly Oubre Jr.'s versatility and experience
quotes.excerpt: He's experienced player. He's started a lot of games in this league.
quotes.quote: He's experienced player. He's started a lot of games in this league. He's played well in the first two games and he's a consistent practice guy. I love his edge, his vibe as a teammate, all those things.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle is impressed with Kelly Oubre Jr. early on, noting his experience and consistent practice habits. Carlisle says he loves his edge and his vibe as a teammate.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. discusses his adjustment to the Pacers' system
quotes.excerpt: I was able to impact the game. I'm still learning, so there's some things that I can get better.
quotes.quote: I think I did pretty well. I was able to impact the game. I'm still learning, so there's some things that I can get better at of course, but I fit seamlessly in with the guys. Very versatile, confident in that, and I just try to be like water. Try to just flow, whatever coach needs me to do I do.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. says he feels he has fit seamlessly into the Pacers system so far. He describes his approach to the new role as trying to be like water and just flowing with whatever the coach needs.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. on learning defensive schemes and team nuances
quotes.excerpt: Just learning the defensive schemes, terminology, being in the right position.
quotes.quote: Just learning the defensive schemes, terminology, being in the right position, figuring out how they close out versus other teams I've been on. It's a lot of details within the game that I'm still learning. Every team is different, but once I get those things down I'm good. As far as fundamentally basketball, I can fit in and I can run with any group.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. is currently focused on learning the Pacers defensive schemes and terminology. He says there are a lot of details to learn but he is confident he can run with any group once he gets them down.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. on the Pacers' fast-paced playing style
quotes.excerpt: I think we could play faster, but it's one thing about playing fast, but another thing about playing with your head.
quotes.quote: I love it. I think we could play faster, but it's one thing about playing fast, but another thing about playing with your head on your shoulders. Just figuring out how we can manipulate the speed versus the quality of possessions and getting exactly what we want every time down.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. likes the Pacers fast-paced style but thinks they can play even faster. He emphasizes the need to balance that speed with playing with your head on your shoulders to ensure quality possessions.

quotes.speaker: Kelly Oubre Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Kelly Oubre Jr. praises Zion Williamson's athleticism and agility
quotes.excerpt: I haven't played with somebody as forceful as him just running to him you're going to fall.
quotes.quote: I love it. I haven't played with somebody as forceful as him just running to him you're going to fall. He's not. So I think it's just amazing that he's so agile, he's so versatile as well. He can move, he can be up on screens, he can be back, and he's just the biggest person I've ever seen in my life. So it's a blessing to be on his side.
quotes.social_post: Kelly Oubre Jr. is amazed by Zion Williamson, calling him the biggest person he has ever seen. He says it is a blessing to be on his side and praises his unique combination of force and agility.
